To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the risk management function of multinational financial institutions (MFIs) has evolved from being a technical and quantitative discipline to a more qualitative and social one.

the global risk of the financial institutions studied has increased, that the motivation of the employees of these institutions to protect the institution has decreased, and that a multiplicity of factors that are underestimated or hidden in the institutions are at the heart of operational losses.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the evolution of risk management within the finance industry since the late 1980s.
the social construction of risk by professionals and how this construction is influenced by the organizational context.
the question of risk-taking in large financial institutions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the risk of the banking sector has increased over the past 30 years, but this increase is not the consequence of the use of financial engineering, which has been used to reduce risk.
the risk-taking behaviour of the financial institutions has increased over the past 30 years and the financial crisis is a direct consequence.
the risk-taking behaviour has been increasing in the banking sector.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
risk management has evolved into a complex and dynamic process that requires a multidimensional analysis.
the risk management of financial institutions has been transformed from the 1980s.
we have found that the risk management in financial firms has been a process where the risk management has become more sophisticated and more complex.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the risk management of financial institutions is a social construction that is subject to change.
the risk-taking of the banking industry is not only driven by financial incentives but by a complex set of social, organizational and individual factors.
the financial industry has been transformed over the last 30 years by the rise of a new type of professional, the risk takers.
